beats.subline: Friday, November 6, 2026 close — the Nasdaq and S&P 500 rebounded from Thursday's AI-chip selloff while the Dow slipped, closing out a losing week for stocks; markets were shut over the weekend with no newer session to report.
beats.body: Chip and AI-infrastructure names that led Thursday's rout, including Nvidia and Micron, bounced back Friday, but the Dow lagged as investors kept weighing the prior session's correction; all three indexes still finished the week lower, and trading resumes Monday.

beats.headline: Bears place RB Zavier Scott on injured reserve, thinning an already short backfield
beats.body: Running back Zavier Scott was placed on injured reserve this week after landing on the Bears' first injury report ahead of Sunday night's game against Tampa Bay, according to the Chicago Tribune's Brad Biggs; the move isn't considered season-ending, but it leaves Chicago thinner at running back with Kyle Monangai still sidelined by thumb and toe injuries.
